_comment: Edit these by hand. Remaining-to-generate on the dashboard is target − actual. Seeded from content-pipeline volume (~150 radicals, ~200 kanji, ~1,450 vocab) with grammar/readings at current shipped counts where generation is done for that level. N4 radicals/kanji are NOT from that seed: they are the settled counts from the 2026-08-10 N4 skeleton pass (KRADFILE-derived decomposition, duplicates of N5 forms removed) — see docs/content/radical-coverage-audit.md. N3/N2/N1 kanji and vocabulary are the band sizes from docs/content/kanji-coverage-and-dependency-order-plan.md; their radical counts are the shipped band split (radicals are partitioned by band, not authored per level), and grammar/readings are 0 because N3+ grammar and passages are not in that plan.
